design.carrier_pool: test clips outside the held direction AND speed bins

readers.fit_rows: 476 probe clips (folds 3-4) outside the 4 held cells; alpha by 5-fold CV; native forecasts from artifacts/session3_speed/native (mask 0, frames 1-8)

keys.predictor.<cond>.<arm>: forecast of the edited context (frames 1-8, delta on every context token at point 22, mask 0), per carrier mean over the 4 held-out target cells; per_clip_ci = mean, SE, 1000-draw clip-bootstrap 95% CI, n carriers
keys.dir_err_deg / speed_err_mps: |direction (speed) ridge probe on the step-mean forecast - target cell theta (speed)|
keys.disp_speed_err_mps / disp_heading_err_de: per-step disk position probes (tubelets 4-7) -> |p7-p4|/3 steps calibrated to m/s on probe clips / world heading of p7-p4, vs the target cell
keys.disp_speed_mps: forecast disk speed read from the per-step positions (m/s, calibrated)
keys.R_*: signed fraction of the target change achieved relative to the unedited forecast (sum_t edit_change * true_change / sum_t true_change^2); 1 = full, 0 = none
keys.R_token_twin_forecast: <Z_edit - Z_src, Z_twin - Z_src> / ||Z_twin - Z_src||^2 over the 4 pooled forecast steps (probe-free), mean over targets
keys.reference.twin_forecast: same readouts on the forecast of the carrier re-rendered at the target cell (physical ceiling)
keys.paired.<cond>.sheet_minus_<arm>_<readout: paired per-carrier difference of the error to target
keys.conditions: own = each arm's own delta norm; sheet_norm = each arm rescaled to the sheet's per-clip norm
